entities.summary: 8888 Uprising, a transformative movement in Myanmar (1988–1988). Emerged from Aung San Suu Kyi emerges as leader of the democratic opposition and Ne Win and the Burmese Way to Socialism. Catalyzed NLD wins 1990 election in a landslide; military refuses to hand over power.
